global:ctrl/any-context.note: Ctrl-\ (Cmd-\ on macOS) toggles the terminal overlay from anywhere, ahead of the vim keys and text fields; the shell keeps running when hidden

global:ctrl-c/embedded-terminal-open.note: with the terminal focused Ctrl-C goes to the shell (its interrupt) instead of the webview

cmd:term.note: :term / :terminal / :shell toggle the terminal overlay; also View > Terminal and the palette

overlay:terminal-overlay-embedded-shell.note: xterm.js over a backend PTY in the open session's working dir; insert mode passes every key to the shell, Esc enters normal mode (i/a, j/k, arrows, g/G, Ctrl-d/u), Ctrl-\ hides. Windows: ConPTY through portable-pty (not yet built or run on Windows).

overlay-ref:terminal.note: other keys go to the shell, Ctrl-C interrupts it, Ctrl-\ closes the overlay

module:ui/overlay/terminal.rs.note: overlay placed like the TUI popup (90% x 80%, centered), one shell per session, all killed on window close. Windows: ConPTY through portable-pty (not yet built or run on Windows).
